fewShots.question: Return raw operational totals across all available approved observations, preserving source and scope metadata and rendering observation extrema and bounds as ISO-8601 UTC text.
fewShots.query:
let StartUtc = datetime(null);
let EndUtc = datetime(null);
AgentRawObservationTotals(StartUtc, EndUtc)
| extend RequestedStartUtc = iff(isnull(RequestedStartUtc), "", strcat(replace_string(format_datetime(RequestedStartUtc, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), " ", "T"), "Z")),
    RequestedEndUtc = iff(isnull(RequestedEndUtc), "", strcat(replace_string(format_datetime(RequestedEndUtc, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), " ", "T"), "Z")),
    TrueFirstObservedAt = iff(isnull(TrueFirstObservedAt), "", strcat(replace_string(format_datetime(TrueFirstObservedAt, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), " ", "T"), "Z")),
    TrueLastObservedAt = iff(isnull(TrueLastObservedAt), "", strcat(replace_string(format_datetime(TrueLastObservedAt, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), " ", "T"), "Z"))

fewShots.question: Return all available approved file/run detail with each source-file, workshop-run and participant-alias key, raw metrics and true observation extrema rendered as ISO-8601 UTC text.
fewShots.query:
let StartUtc = datetime(null);
let EndUtc = datetime(null);
AgentFileRunSummary(StartUtc, EndUtc)
| extend FirstObservedAtUtc = iff(isnull(FirstObservedAtUtc), "", strcat(replace_string(format_datetime(FirstObservedAtUtc, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), " ", "T"), "Z")),
    LastObservedAtUtc = iff(isnull(LastObservedAtUtc), "", strcat(replace_string(format_datetime(LastObservedAtUtc, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), " ", "T"), "Z")),
    RequestedStartUtc = iff(isnull(RequestedStartUtc), "", strcat(replace_string(format_datetime(RequestedStartUtc, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), " ", "T"), "Z")),
    RequestedEndUtc = iff(isnull(RequestedEndUtc), "", strcat(replace_string(format_datetime(RequestedEndUtc, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), " ", "T"), "Z"))
